---
title: "Fig. 3E - Shrb RNAi Vsg+ ring canal-to-cell ratio"
output: null
date: "2026-03-11"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggprism)
library(ggpubr)
source("analysis_helpers.R")
```

```{r}
# Fig. 3E: calculate Vsg+ ring canal-to-follicle-cell ratio for each germarium.

data_file <- "../Data/Fig3E_shrbRNAi_Vsg_RC_to_cell_ratio.csv"
output_file <- "../Results/Fig3E_shrbRNAi_Vsg_RC_to_cell_ratio.pdf"

shrb_rnai_vsgrings_totalcells <- read_analysis_csv(data_file) %>%
  mutate(Vsg_Ring_to_Cell_Ratio = VsgRings / TotalCells)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 3E: average ratios within each replicate for statistical testing.
# Individual germaria are shown as points in the plot.

shrb_rnai_vsgrings_totalcells_summary <- shrb_rnai_vsgrings_totalcells %>%
  group_by(Genotype, Group, Replicate) %>%
  summarise(
    Vsg_Ring_to_Cell_Ratio = mean(Vsg_Ring_to_Cell_Ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# Fig. 3E: compare replicate means between control and shrb RNAi.

stat_results <- shrb_rnai_vsgrings_totalcells_summary %>%
  group_by(Genotype) %>%
  rstatix::t_test(Vsg_Ring_to_Cell_Ratio ~ Group) %>%
  rstatix::add_significance("p") %>%
  rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "Group", step.increase = 2, dodge = 0.8)
print(stat_results)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 3E: plot Vsg+ ring canal-to-cell ratios.

plot_box_jitter(
  data = shrb_rnai_vsgrings_totalcells,
  summary_data = shrb_rnai_vsgrings_totalcells_summary,
  x = Group,
  y = Vsg_Ring_to_Cell_Ratio,
  plot_title = "Vsg+ ring canal to\ntotal follicle cell ratio",
  y_limits = c(0, 1.5),
  x_labels = c("Control", "shrb [RNAi]"),
  p_values = stat_results,
  bracket_size = 0.3,
  p_value_size = 2.5
)
```
```{r}
ggsave(output_file, width = 2.125, height = 3, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 3E: manuscript summary values for replicate means. 

summarize_mean_sd(
  shrb_rnai_vsgrings_totalcells_summary,
  group_cols = "Group",
  value_col = Vsg_Ring_to_Cell_Ratio
)
```
